title: Detailed volcano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky glow behind volcano -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='45' ry='28' fill='#3a1e4f'/>
  <!-- distant haze -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='40' ry='8' fill='#5b2a6e'/>
  <!-- mountain body -->
  <path d='M8 88 L38 34 L46 40 L50 30 L54 40 L62 34 L92 88 Z' fill='#6b4a3a'/>
  <!-- mountain shadow side -->
  <path d='M50 30 L54 40 L62 34 L92 88 L50 88 Z' fill='#573a2e'/>
  <!-- snow/ash cap -->
  <path d='M38 34 L44 42 L50 30 L56 42 L62 34 L66 44 L58 46 L50 40 L42 46 L34 44 Z' fill='#c9b8d6'/>
  <!-- crater -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#3a1e4f'/>
  <!-- lava pool in crater -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='4.5' ry='1.8' fill='#ff7a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='2.2' ry='0.9' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- lava stream left -->
  <path d='M48 35 Q46 50 42 62 Q40 72 36 84 L33 84 Q36 70 38 60 Q42 48 45 36 Z' fill='#ff5a1a'/>
  <path d='M47 36 Q45.5 48 42.5 60 Q41 68 38.5 80 L37 80 Q39 68 40.5 60 Q43.5 48 45.5 36 Z' fill='#ffb300'/>
  <!-- lava stream right -->
  <path d='M53 36 Q56 50 60 64 Q63 74 66 86 L69 86 Q66 72 63 62 Q59 48 56 36 Z' fill='#ff5a1a'/>
  <path d='M54 37 Q56.5 50 59.5 62 Q62 71 64 82 L65.5 82 Q63.5 71 61 62 Q58 50 55.5 37 Z' fill='#ffb300'/>
  <!-- glowing cracks -->
  <path d='M30 70 L36 74 L33 80' stroke='#ff8c2a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 66 L74 72 L71 78' stroke='#ff8c2a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 58 L48 60 L47 66' stroke='#ff8c2a' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- glowing embers rising -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='24' r='1.4' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='20' r='1.1' fill='#ff9a2a'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='15' r='1.5' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='12' r='0.9' fill='#ff7a1a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='18' r='1' fill='#ffb300'/>
  <!-- smoke puffs -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='12' r='4' fill='#7a5a8a' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='10' r='5' fill='#8a6a9a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='5' r='4.5' fill='#9a7aaa' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- ground base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='46' ry='7' fill='#4a2f3a'/>
</svg>
